Moreover, ILVES-PC solves the necessary linear systems using a specialized linear solver that exploits the structure of the protein.

where \(q\) is position, \(p\) is momentum, \(M\) is the diagonal mass matrix, and \(\gamma,\,\sigma\) are positive constants.
